profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: I like to use software to solve interesting problems.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Everything from Mobile App and Website Development to Marketing and Finance back to linux and system integration.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
	Application development and maintenance.
	Analyze new technologies and integrate into existing systems.
	Perform system and software testing.
	Prepare and peer review technical documents
	Provide technical guidance to customers and team members.

positions.title: Data Entry / Call Operator
positions.description:
 Communicated with customers and provided search results in a clear and effective manner.
 Accessed a national database of over 150 million records using a wide variety of parameters and logical operators.
 Provided enhanced customer services that included giving turn-by-turn driving directions, making restaurant reservations, transmitting requested text messages, providing movie listings, performing categorical searches and supplying reverse directory look-up information.
